prompt: The payment provider may resend notifications. Retried notifications should not duplicate payments or move an order through its state more than once. Notification verification must stay enforced.
issue_title: Retried provider notifications can update an order more than once
issue_body: The payment provider may resend notifications. Retried notifications should not duplicate payments or move an order through its state more than once. Notification verification must stay enforced.
expected_behavior: Replayed notifications do not duplicate payments or change invoice totals.
Distinct successful notifications for the same order follow the existing payment-reference rules.
Signature verification stays enforced before any state change.
expected_failure_summary: WebhookService::handle no longer short-circuits on a previously processed eventId nor on an already-reconciled payment reference, so a resent notification records a second payment and inflates invoice paidCents. Separately, the failed-status branch now unconditionally forces the order to FAILED and saves it, so a later failed notification pulls an already-paid order back to failed.
task_author_notes: Two coupled defects in WebhookService::handle. (1) Restore the two replay guards: the idempotency->hasProcessed(eventId) duplicate return and the already_reconciled short-circuit when an existing PAID payment with the same reference is seen. (2) Restore the failed-status branch so it only saves a PENDING order with no prior PAID payment instead of unconditionally forcing FAILED. On broken these fail: same_event_replay_*, distinct_event_same_reference_no_double_pay, out_of_order_handled, and failed_after_paid_keeps_paid (the new coupled check). invalid_signature_rejected and failed_then_success pass on broken. A minimal fix of only the replay guards leaves failed_after_paid_keeps_paid failing; the failed-branch fix is also required.
